name: Soft parallax
technique: yPercent -10 on image inside overflow mask

name: Darkroom Develop
avoid: product photos people need to judge

name: Logo morph
use_for: logo to icon, letter to symbol

name: DOM-synced WebGL planes
technique: one canvas, planes matched to img rects

name: Type film
technique: DOM timeline duration 1 with scene positions

name: Toast enter
avoid: errors that need reading time (keep them, don't auto-hide)

name: Menu sheet
technique: clip-path inset from top + opacity; close 180ms

name: Skeleton to content
technique: skeleton opacity 1 to 0 while content opacity 0 to 1
use_for: lists and cards that load over 300ms

name: Count up
technique: tabular number from 0 to value, final value in the HTML
avoid: prices, legal figures, every number on the page

name: Typewriter
technique: characters revealed with a caret, 35ms per character, 600ms hold
use_for: one short line that is spoken

name: Rotating words
technique: one word swapped with yPercent 100 to 0, holds 2400ms
use_for: one changing noun in a headline
avoid: more than 4 words; the key claim

name: Stagger grid
technique: items y 16 + opacity, stagger from the start corner

name: Magnetic pull
technique: translate toward pointer, max 6px, spring back

name: Image trail
technique: images spawned on pointer path, each fades over 900ms
avoid: pages where the pointer is needed for reading

name: Sticky index
technique: sticky list, active item by IntersectionObserver, colour change

name: Scroll float
technique: letters yPercent 120 to 0 with stagger 0.03 across the scrub
avoid: body text, more than one per page

name: Letter relay
technique: letters handed down a line, 25ms stagger

name: Page fade
technique: old page opacity to 0 (150ms) then new page in (250ms)
use_for: small sites with no shared elements

name: Shared image transition
technique: view-transition-name on the card image and the hero image
avoid: lists where many images share a name

name: Liquid hover
technique: fragment shader displacement around the pointer, radius 120px
use_for: one hero image with a material concept

name: Chapter cut
technique: hard cut between frame ranges with a 2-frame flash
reduced_fallback: storyboard frame of the next chapter
